blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo takes his oath as a defense witness on Day 45 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Friday, Nov. 20. Defense counsel Justin Nicol Gular says Rodolfo will testify that Cale88 Foods Corp. is registered with the DTI and is engaged in the “lawful and legitimate business of producing and exporting banana chips.”/dp READ: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 20, 2026...
